items.source_text: Hegseth, the United States secretary of defense, has publicly rebuked Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei's approach to artificial intelligence.
items.expected_summary: Dario Amodei is Anthropic's chief executive.

items.source_text: Anthropic's strategy has mirrored Amodei's views toward Trump; in a Facebook post ahead of the 2024 presidential election, Amodei urged his associates to vote for vice president Kamala Harris over Trump, describing him as a "feudal warlord".
items.expected_summary: Anthropic's strategy mirrored Dario Amodei's views toward Trump.

items.source_text: [9] Through  its  interoperability  with  Palantir,  a  company  heavily involved in data analysis and analytics at the Department of Defense, Anthropic's technology achieved relatively widespread usage in the U.S. military.
items.expected_summary: Anthropic's technology had relatively widespread use in the U.S. military.
